implementation: Add import at top: import { similarity } from 'ml-distance'

Replace cosineSimilarity method body: private cosineSimilarity(a: number[], b: number[]): number { if (a.length !== b.length || a.length === 0) return 0; try { return similarity.cosine(a, b); } catch { return 0; } }
Keep validation for length mismatch and empty arrays
Wrap in try-catch for edge cases (NaN, Infinity)

tasks.title: Pre-normalize embeddings for faster comparison
tasks.description: Pre-normalize embedding vectors when stored, allowing dot product instead of full cosine similarity (dot product of normalized vectors = cosine similarity)

modification_points.description: Add normalization step and use dot product for comparison

implementation: Add normalizeVector helper: private normalizeVector(v: number[]): number[] { const norm = Math.sqrt(v.reduce((sum, x) => sum + x * x, 0)); return norm === 0 ? v : v.map(x => x / norm); }
Normalize new embeddings before storage in processItem
For comparison, use dot product: const dotProduct = a.reduce((sum, ai, i) => sum + ai * b[i], 0)
Update findSimilarByEmbedding to use dot product for pre-normalized vectors

unit: Test dot product of normalized vectors equals cosine similarity
Test performance improvement with dot product

criteria: New embeddings are normalized before storage

Results identical to cosine similarity within floating point tolerance
